featured_reviews.name: GM Lotlikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am totally disappointed and heartbroken with my experience at Yoda NGO situated at Malad Chikuwadi. I had sent my cat for sterilization and kept following up from day one, but my messages and calls were continuously ignored. Despite my repeated requests for updates, I wasn’t informed about my cat’s condition or whereabouts.

After 15 days of constant follow-ups, I was shocked to learn that my cat had been released five days earlier without any prior intimation or confirmation from me. To make things worse, my cat was left without my permission in a location that is extremely difficult to find. This is extremely irresponsible and careless behavior.

Animals are not just “cases” they are family. My cat was like my baby.  I had some emotional sentiments connection with my cat. NGOs like Yoda are expected to show compassion, transparency, and accountability, not negligence. What happened to my cat should never happen to anyone else.

Please, if you truly care for animals, think twice before trusting this organization with your pets.

#AnimalWelfare #AccountabilityMatters #YodaNGO #AnimalCare

description:

description: We are a non-profit, no kill shelter for all breeds of dogs and cats. We are a caring stray and pet animals shelter situated right 9n the cost of Manori Jetty Malad west. Founded in June 2002, we rescue and care for homeless animals. Most of the dogs and cats that we take in are from high kill facilities that are euthanizing due to lack of space. Many have been abused, neglected or abandoned . Once rehabilitated and ready, they are carefully matched with prospective adopters and placed in loving homes. We do take in some owner relinquishments as well and there are a variety of reasons people give up their dog or cat to us. The most common reasons are lack of time due to a change in work schedule, moving, allergies, new baby etc.

customer_updates.name: Vijay Patil
customer_updates.text:
ज़रूरी सूचना / Urgent Notice
हिन्दी:
नमस्ते,
मैंने एक कुत्ते को देखा है जिसे तुरंत मदद की ज़रूरत है।
कुत्ते की स्थिति:
* वह बीमार दिख रहा है।
* वह अस्वाभाविक रूप से व्यवहार कर रहा था (मेरे पीछे आ रहा था, दूसरे कुत्तों पर हमला कर रहा था)।
* उसके मुँह से लार या झाग निकल रहा था।
* वह बहुत आक्रामक लग रहा था।
कृपया जल्द से जल्द इसकी मदद करें।
धन्यवाद।
English:
Hello,
I have seen a dog that urgently needs help.
Dog's Condition:
* It appears to be sick.
* It was behaving unusually (following me, attacking other dogs).
* There was saliva or foam coming from its mouth.
* It seemed very aggressive.
Please provide assistance as soon as possible.
Thank you.
मराठी:
नमस्कार,
मला एक कुत्रा दिसला आहे ज्याला त्वरित मदतीची गरज आहे.
कुत्र्याची स्थिती:
* तो आजारी दिसत आहे.
* तो असामान्यपणे वागत होता (माझ्या मागे येत होता, इतर कुत्र्यांवर हल्ला करत होता).
* त्याच्या तोंडातून लाळ किंवा फेस बाहेर येत होता.
* तो खूप आक्रमक वाटत होता.
कृपया लवकरच याला मदत करा.
धन्यवाद.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This NGO truly sets a gold standard in social service. Their team is upfront, proactive, and available 24×7, which is rare and incredibly reassuring. No matter the time or situation, they step in immediately and take responsibility rather than making excuses.

What really stands out is their willingness to go the extra mile—sometimes even beyond what is expected or required—to ensure real help reaches those in need. Their work is driven by compassion, transparency, and action, not just words.

It’s organizations like this that restore faith in humanity. Deep respect and gratitude to the entire team for their tireless dedication and selfless service. Highly recommended and truly trustworthy. 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Bala Jogale
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience with Animal Rescue and Shelter Foundation. They took very good care of my three cats, making sure they were well-fed, comfortable, and safe. The shelter was clean and hygienic, and the team was very kind and caring towards the animals. I truly appreciate their dedication and would definitely recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: namrata katwankar
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you for the incredible work you do for helpless kittens and abandoned animals. Your kindness, care, and dedication are truly inspiring. Because of your efforts, many innocent lives get a second chance to live safely and happily. The world really needs more people and foundations like yours. Keep doing this amazing work. 🐾❤️

featured_reviews.name: Azim Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank this animal shelter enough for the incredible help they gave me during a very stressful night. When I was in urgent need and didn’t know where to turn, they stepped in with compassion, professionalism, and genuine care for my Labrador.

Even at night, their team was responsive, calm, and incredibly kind. They treated my dog as if he were their own, which immediately put me at ease. In a moment of panic, their support meant everything to me.

This shelter isn’t just a place for animals — it’s a place full of people with big hearts who truly care. I’ll always be grateful for their night-time help and would highly recommend them to anyone who needs support for their pet in an emergency.

featured_reviews.name: Pratiksha Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I do NOT recommend this rescue service at all.
I found a small puppy on the road and took care of him for almost a month with proper food and attention. Trusting them, I handed him over for rescue, as they assured me of proper care, checkup, and vaccination.
However, after they took the puppy, they completely stopped answering calls and messages. When we personally visited their location later, we were shocked to see the puppy’s condition had become much worse. There was no proper care, no medical treatment, and no vaccination as promised.
This is extremely irresponsible and heartbreaking. Please do not trust them with any animal’s life. Animals deserve love and proper care, not neglect like this.

featured_reviews.name: dhiraj tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when help is needed not tomorrow, not in the morning—but right now. This NGO was a true lifesaver for me at midnight, when I had almost lost hope. They didn’t just respond quickly; they responded with genuine care, empathy, and respect.

A very special mention to Bhavesh, the real protagonist who stepped in and treated me with incredible hospitality and kindness. He made sure I felt safe, supported, and heard—something you never forget in times of distress.

This organization doesn’t just “help” people; they stand by you when it matters most. If you’re ever in need or looking to support an NGO that truly makes a difference on the ground, I wholeheartedly recommend them. Eternal gratitude 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: Manisha Pal

He saved 2 kitties from our area came for immediate assistance formalities were very smooth.. one of the best organisation for animal rescue and adoption center..

featured_reviews.name: Khushi Kachalia
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a stray kitten that no one was willing to adopt, her mom had died and we just picked her up off the street with no knowledge of how to care for her. We couldn't keep her because we could not transport her back to our home, and we already had a dog. She had fleas and worms and we were terrified about what to do for her. We called ARAS in the morning and they got back to us immediately and in the next 2-3 hours the founder came to pick her up. He even explained that you may video call the foundation or request pictures to check in on the animal. The work these people are doing is incredible, and the complaints about the request for donations is completely unjustified. Pets are expensive, these people are paying rent for a property as well as feeding, grooming, and giving medical care to over some 60 animals. A big thank you to Bhavesh Jain and everyone else working for this foundation ! As for Ginger, I hope someone will adopt her, she's very sweet, loves to cuddle and only 1.5-2 months old. There are pictures of her below, and if you are interested go ahead and give this number a call. 😄

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best and genuine animal welfare NGOs I’ve come across. I discovered them in 2021 and have seen them grow tremendously over time. What makes them truly special is their team - including school and college students, working professionals, and dedicated animal lovers across age groups, all coming together for a common cause.

I’ve had the opportunity to closely work with the team, and their dedication is truly commendable. Animal welfare isn’t easy, it involves making tough and critical decisions but they continue to give their best and often go out of their way to help animals. Truly inspiring work!

featured_reviews.name: richa sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt thank you to Founder Sushank and CAP Organisation for giving this sweet soul the better life she truly deserved. From severe skin infection to healing and hope, Mili’s transformation (before and after pic) says it all. She is a street dog near our apartment, and today she has a new chance at life. Every soul on the streets deserves love, dignity, and care, and CAP continues to serve this cause in every way they can.

This is not the only case they have helped us with—they have supported 2–3 more dogs as well, always stepping in selflessly. They never asked us for donations for treatment, but we felt it was our responsibility to contribute and support such genuine work.

Requesting everyone to please support them in whatever way possible. They may not have big backing, but they have big hearts. ♥️

featured_reviews.name: Meera Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
A 12-year-old dog from my college had a uterine prolapse, and when no one else responded or was ready to help, CAP Foundation immediately stepped in. They took her in, made sure she got the surgery she needed, and cared for her through the entire recovery.
The team was so kind, responsive, and genuinely concerned about her well-being. They kept her till she fully healed and treated her with so much love and patience.
Truly grateful for everything they did, CAP didn’t just help my dog heal, they gave her comfort and dignity when she needed it most.🙌

featured_reviews.name: Simmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Vet 4 Pet Clinic and consulted Dr. Abhishek Sharma yesterday morning after urgently searching for a vet, as most clinics were closed at that time. I had rescued kitten who was in a very critical condition she couldn’t even stand properly and wasn’t eating or drinking anything. I honestly feared she might not survive.

But Dr. Abhishek handled the situation very calmly and professionally. After the first check up, he assured me that the kitten would start eating a bit within an hour or so. To my surprise, exactly that happened & she began eating as soon as we reached back home.

I can already see a significant improvement in her condition, and I will definitely continue her treatment here.

Highly grateful for the care and would strongly recommend this clinic to everyone looking for a reliable and compassionate vet.
